summary_md: **Serhii Shyman ([@5haman](https://x.com/5haman/status/2115863794136093081))** lists agent repos worth checking, including **Foreman** (a supervisor that checks progress and test evidence before declaring work done), **LongHorizon-Harness** (checkpoints and recovery across context resets), **Coworker** (desktop assistant with reviewable memory) and **Cezar** (parallel coding agents) ([foreman](https://github.com/thruwire/foreman), [LongHorizon-Harness](https://github.com/AMAP-ML/LongHorizon-Harness), [coworker](https://github.com/donvito/coworker), [cezar](https://github.com/open-mercato/cezar), plus [bb](https://github.com/get-bb/bb), [fractal](https://github.com/plasma-ai/fractal), [okf-agent-memory](https://github.com/okf-memory/okf-agent-memory), [reef](https://github.com/Human-Agent-Society/reef), [temper](https://github.com/nerdsane/temper), [treg](https://github.com/superdesigndev/treg)).
